brief:
Israeli occupation forces have prevented approximately 30 residents from entering Beit Iksa village, northwest of Jerusalem, for the second consecutive week, Shehab Wire reported. The Palestinians remain unable to access their homes during the ongoing restrictions.

The blockade, now in its second week with no stated endpoint, has left dozens of villagers cut off from their residences. No official justification for the measure has been provided by Israeli authorities, and there is no indication when access to Beit Iksa will be restored to affected residents.
